findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: No .editorconfig or formatter/analyzer config found to enforce the observed formatting conventions

evidence.excerpt: no .editorconfig at repo root or under src/test

findings.recommendation: Add a .editorconfig (and optionally `dotnet format` in CI) so the currently-consistent tab indentation and brace style stay enforced as the team grows.

findings.subject: Implementation
findings.title: The IDbConnection created in TestingRepository is closed but never disposed via a using statement
findings.recommendation: Wrap the connection in a `using`/`await using` declaration instead of manually calling Close() in a finally block, so Dispose() always runs even if Close() itself throws.
